_comment: Fixed scenario set for scripts/token-bench.mjs (Phase 1 P17).
Each scenario opens a NEW v2 chat; every turn of a multi-turn scenario reuses
that chat. `mode` is sent explicitly so the classifier never runs (its own
call would be part of the measurement). The bench creates a temp workspace
holding notes.txt; the prompts refer to it.
Change a prompt only together with a new token-baseline.json.

turns: Explain in three sentences what notes.txt contains.
In notes.txt, change the word 'alpha' to 'beta' and tell me when it is done.
Plan one step: add a second line to notes.txt that says 'gamma'.
Remember the code word is 'amber'. Reply with OK only.
What code word did I ask you to remember? Reply with the word only.
